lyrics:
ഇപ്പോ ശരിയാക്കിത്തരാം...

Darling, open the door...

Darling, open the door...

Why are you angry so?

Darling, open the door...

Darling, open the door...

Why are you angry so?

I will take you to China 

And give you my Mynah...

Why are you angry so?

Darling, open the door...

Darling, open the door...

Why are you angry so?

I will take you to Delhi 

And give you some Lilly...

Why are you angry so?

Darling, open the door...

Darling, open the door...

Why are you angry so?

I will take you to a taxi 

And give you a Maxie...

Why are you angry so?

Darling, open the door...

Darling, open the door...

Why are you angry so?

I will take you to a mountain 

And show you the fountains...

Why are you angry so?

Darling, open the door...

Darling, open the door...

Why are you angry so?

Open Darling and Give me some pickle!
